summary.headline: Mars in the Planetary Houses
summary.text: Astrological judgments for Mars in the houses of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, and Mercury, including effects in Aquarius, Capricorn, Aries, Scorpio, Libra, and Taurus on character, fortune, wealth, occupations, injury, death, and sexual conduct.
